title: MORNING WARFARE PRAYER FOR PROSPERITY
text: Beloved, before we go into the place of prayer this morning, I want you to do something for me. I want you to share this prayer with someone. Don't keep it to yourself. There is a protocol in the kingdom. When you become a distributor of grace, you become a candidate for unusual grace. When you share the word, when you distribute what God is doing, you position yourself for acceleration. So right now, take a moment and send this to at least three people. Send it to your family members. Send it to that friend who is struggling financially. Send it to that business partner who needs a breakthrough. The Bible says in Proverbs 11:25, "The liberal soul shall be made fat, and he that waterth shall be watered also himself. When you water others, heaven positions you for watering." So don't just receive this prayer, become a distributor of it. Share it now. And as you do, I decree that the windows of heaven are opening over your life in the name of Jesus. Now, I want you to understand something this morning. We are not gathering here just to say prayers. We're gathering here to engage the dynamics of the spirit realm to enforce the victory that Christ has already won and to pull down every structure that the enemy has raised against your prosperity. The Bible says in Ephesians 6:12, "For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness [music] in high places. This morning, we are not fighting against your boss. We are not fighting against the economy. We are not fighting against your background. We are dealing with the spiritual forces that have been assigned to frustrate your prosperity. Many believers are poor not because God has not blessed them but because there are spiritual forces intercepting their blessings. There are satanic agents in the second heaven who have been assigned to delay to divert to destroy everything that is coming toward you from the throne of grace. And this morning by the authority of the Lord Jesus Christ we are going to dismantle every one of those altars. We are going to pull down every tone. [music] We're going to silence every voice that is speaking against your financial advancement. Because the Bible is clear in Deuteronomy 8:18, "But thou shalt remember the Lord thy God, for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant, which he swear unto thy fathers, as it is this day." God wants to give you power to get wealth not just to make you comfortable but to establish his covenant in the earth. Your prosperity is covenant property. It is not a luxury. It is a necessity for the fulfillment of divine agenda. And every force that is standing between you and that covenant. Prosperity [music] must bow this morning in the name of Jesus. I want you to get violent in your spirit. This is not the time to pray casually. This is not the time to pray religiously. This is the time to engage [music] in militant warfare. The kingdom of heaven suffers violence and the violent take it by force. Now I want to take you into the scriptures because everything we do must be founded on the word of God. The Bible says in Psalm 35-27, "Let them shout for joy and be glad that favor my righteous cause. Yay, let the Lord be magnified which hath pleasure in the prosperity of his servant. Do you see that God takes pleasure in your prosperity? It is not pride for you to desire wealth when that wealth will be used to advance the kingdom. It is not canality for you to want financial breakthrough when that breakthrough will make you a blessing to nations. God actually delights when his children prosper because prosperity in the hands of the righteous becomes a weapon of kingdom advancement. But the enemy knows this. Satan understands that when believers break through financially, they become dangerous to his kingdom. When you have resources, you can fund missions, you can build churches, you can support the gospel, you can rescue the perishing, you can establish kingdom infrastructure. And so the kingdom of darkness has assigned specific spirits to ensure that believers remain perpetually broke, perpetually struggling, perpetually barely getting by. These are spirits of poverty, spirits of debt, spirits of financial leakage, spirits of wastage, spirits of demotion, spirits [music] of stagnation. And this morning, every single one of them must release you in the name of Jesus. I'm seeing something in the spirit. I'm seeing angels that have been dispatched from the throne room with financial packages, with contracts, with business ideas, with opportunities, but they have been hindered in the second heaven. Just like in Daniel chapter 10 where the angel told Daniel, "From the first day that you set your heart to understand, your prayer was heard, but the prince of Pesha withtood me 21 days. There are blessings that have been on their way to you, but territorial spirits have been blocking them. This morning, we are going to command those angels to break through. We are going to paralyze every hindering spirit. We are going to clear the pathway for your blessings to locate you. Let me tell you what warfare prayer is. Warfare prayer is not [music] begging God. Warfare prayer is enforcing what God has already said. When you understand your authority in Christ, you [music] stop begging and you start commanding. You stop asking and you start decreeing. The Bible says in Job 22:28, "Thou shalt also decree a thing, and it shall be established unto thee, and the light shall shine upon thy ways." You have the authority to decree. You have the legal right in the spirit realm to make declarations that will shift atmospheres that will break yolks that will open doors that will release resources. But many believers pray without authority because they don't understand their identity in Christ. The Bible says in Luke 10:19, "Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions and over all the power of the enemy, and nothing shall by any means hurt you. You have been given power over ll the [music] power of the enemy. Not some of the power. Not most of the power. Ll the power. That means every demon, every witch, every warlock, every satanic agent, every ancestral spirit, every household wickedness, every marine power, every territorial force, all of them are under your feet. But if you don't know this, if you don't believe this, if you don't operate in this, they will continue to oppress you. This morning, I want you to rise up in your spirit. I want you to recognize who you are. You are not a beggar. You are not a victim. You are not ordinary. You are a son of God, a daughter of the most high, seated with Christ in heavenly places, far above all principality and power and might and dominion. from that position. We're going to pray this morning. Not from a position of defeat, but from a position of victory. Not from a position of fear, but from a position of faith. Not from a position of weakness, but from a position of authority. Now, let's talk about prosperity for a moment. Prosperity is not just about money, though money is part of it. Prosperity is God's will for every area of your life. The Bible says in 3 John 1:2, "Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health even as thy soul prospereth." God wants you to [music] prosper in your finances, prosper in your health, prosper in your relationships, prosper in your business, prosper in your career, prosper in your ministry, prosper in your family. Total allound prosperity. That is the will of God for your life. And anything that is standing in the way of that prosperity is standing in the way of God's will and it [music] must be removed by fire. But I want you to understand that there are levels to prosperity. There is natural prosperity that comes through hard work and diligence. Proverbs 10:4 says, "He becometh poor that dealth with a slack hand, but the hand of the diligent maketh rich." God expects you to walk. God expects you to be faithful. God expects you to be excellent in whatever you do. But beyond natural prosperity, there is supernatural prosperity. This is when God suddenly opens doors that no man can shut. This is when God connects you with opportunities that you didn't apply for. This is when God causes people to favor you for no natural reason. This is when your business begins to grow at a rate that defies economic logic. This is when money begins to pursue you instead of you pursuing money. And this morning I am decreeing supernatural prosperity over your life. I am calling forth unusual financial breakthroughs. I am summoning uncommon favor. I am prophesying acceleration into your account, into your business, into your career. Things that have taken others 10 years to achieve, you will achieve in one year. Things that have taken others 20 years to build, you will build in [music] 2 years. Because when God accelerates a man, when God accelerates a woman, time becomes irrelevant. The Bible says in Isaiah 60-22, "A little one [music] shall become a thousand and a small one a strong nation. I the Lord will hasten it in his time. God will hasten your breakthrough. God will speed up your promotion. God will fast track your elevation. But for this to happen, we must deal with the hindrances. We must confront the spirits that are blocking your progress. Let me mention some of them. There is a spirit called the spirit of poverty. This spirit specializes in keeping people perpetually broke no matter how hard they work. You labor and labor and labor, but at the end of the month, you have nothing to show for it. Money comes and money goes. You can't seem to save. You can't seem to invest. You're always solving one problem or another. That is the spirit of poverty at work. And I'm telling you this morning, that spirit is being arrested right now in the name of Jesus. There is also a spirit called the spirit of debt. This spirit puts people in perpetual indebtedness. You're always owing somebody. Credit cards maxed out, loans everywhere, borrowing to survive, borrowing to eat. The Bible says in Proverbs 22:7, "The rich rule over the poor, and the borrower is servant to the lender." God doesn't want you to be a servant to any man. God wants you to be the lender, not the borrower. Deuteronomy 28:12 says, "The Lord shall open unto thee his good treasure, the heaven to give the rain unto thy land in his season, and to bless all the work of thine hand, and thou shalt lend unto many nations, and thou shalt not borrow." This morning, the spirit of debt is broken off your life. Every cycle of borrowing is terminated. Every chain of indebtedness is shattered in Jesus name. There is the spirit of demotion. This spirit ensures that instead of going forward, you're going backward. [music] Instead of promotion, demotion. Instead of increase, decrease. Instead of expansion, reduction. People who were below you are now above you. People who started after you have overtaken you. That is demotion at work. But the Bible says in Psalm 75-6-7, "For promotion cometh neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the south. But God is the judge. He putth down one and setth up another." This morning, every spirit of demotion is cast out. Every force pulling you backward is [music] paralyzed. I decree promotion over your life. I decree elevation. I decree advancement in the name of Jesus. You are moving forward and not backward. There is the spirit of limitation. This spirit puts a ceiling on your life. You can only go this far and no further. You reach a certain level and you get stuck year after year. Same level, same position, same salary, same business turnover. That is the spirit of limitation. But I'm declaring over you this morning, your limitations are expired. Every ceiling is broken. Every boundary is extended. The Bible says in Isaiah 54:2, "Enlarge the place of thy tent, and let them stretch forth the curtains of thine habitations. Spare not, lengthen thy cords, and strengthen thy stakes." You are entering into a season of enlargement. Your territory is expanding. Your capacity is increasing. Your influence is multiplying. Now, there are also ancestral spirits that fight prosperity. These are spirits that have been in your family line for generations, ensuring that nobody in your family prospers. Your grandfather was poor, your father was poor, and now they want you to be poor. They want to continue the cycle. But I'm here to tell you this morning, you are a cycle breaker. You are a generational cerebreaker. You are the one who changed the story of your family. The Bible says in Galatians 3:13:14, "Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a cause for us. For it is written, cursed is everyone that hangeth on [music] a tree, that the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Jesus Christ. Every ancestral cause of poverty is broken. Every generational limitation is destroyed. The blessings of Abraham are now your portion. I see some of you right now and you've been faithful. You've been praying. You've been sewing. You've been giving. But it seems like nothing is changing. Let me tell you what's happening. Your breakthrough is in transit. It is on the way. But there is warfare in the spirit [music] realm. And you must not give up now. You must press through. You must contend. You must fight. The Bible says in 1 Timothy 6:12, "Fight the good fight of faith. Lay hold on eternal life where unto thou art also called." This is a fight. Faith is not passive. Faith is active. Faith is militant. Faith contends. Faith presses. Faith perseveres until the manifestation comes. And so this morning, we are going to pray with violence. We are going to pray with intensity. We're going to pray with authority. And as we pray, I want you to engage your faith. Don't just listen to me. Pray. Pray with me. Agree with me. When I make a declaration, say amen with conviction. When I give a command, release your faith. Because the Bible says in Matthew 18:19, "Again, I say unto you that if two of you shall agree on earth as touching anything that they shall ask, it shall be done for them of my father which is in heaven." We are agreeing this morning and heaven is responding. Now lift up your voice with me. Don't pray silently. Pray out loud. The Bible says in Joel 3:16, "The Lord also shall roar out of Zion and utter his voice from Jerusalem." There is power [music] in your voice. When you decree with your mouth, you are releasing creative power. You are activating angelic assistance. You are enforcing divine will. So open your mouth and pray. Father, in the mighty name of Jesus [music] Christ, I come before your throne this morning with boldness. Your word says in Hebrews 4:16 that I can come boldly onto the throne of grace to obtain mercy and find [music] grace to help in time of need. Father, I thank you that you have given me access [music] into your presence through the blood of Jesus. I thank you that I am not standing here as a stranger, but as a son, as a daughter, as an heir of God and joint heir with Christ, and from that position of [music] sunship, I make my demands known this morning. Father, your word declares in Philippians 4:19 that you shall supply all my need according to your riches in glory by Christ Jesus. I hold you to your word this morning. every financial need, every material need, every resource that I require to fulfill my assignment on earth. Father, I demand their release in the name of Jesus. Let every storehouse of heaven be opened. Let every reservoir of blessing be poured out. Let every divine allocation that belongs to me be released right now in Jesus name. and I come against every power, every spirit, every force, every entity that has been assigned to block my prosperity. I bind you right now by the authority in the name of Jesus Christ. I paralyze your operations. I terminate your assignment. I dismantle your structure. Every altar speaking against my finances, I command fire from heaven to consume that altar right now. Every sacrifice offered against my business, I nullify that sacrifice by the blood of Jesus. Every incantation, every enchantment, every divination, every witchcraft manipulation against my prosperity, I render it powerless in the name of Jesus. Spirit of poverty, I arrest you. I bind you. I cast you out of my life. You have no more permission to operate in my finances. Spirit of debt, you are terminated. Every cycle of borrowing is broken. Every chain of indebtedness is shattered. I decree that I shall lend to nations and not borrow. Spirit of demotion, you are paralyzed. Every force pulling me backward is destroyed. I decree that I am moving forward. I am going higher. I am advancing into new levels. Spirit of limitation, your hold on my life is broken. Every ceiling is shattered. Every boundary is pushed back. I am entering into unlimited dimensions of [music] prosperity. Every ancestral spirit fighting my prosperity, I command you to release me and go by the power in the blood of Jesus. Every generational cause of poverty is broken. Every family pattern [music] of lack is destroyed. I am a new creation in Christ Jesus. Old things have passed away. All things have become new. The blessings of Abraham are now my portion. The wealth of the sinner is now laid up for me. I am blessed coming in and blessed going out. I am the head and not the tail. I am above only and not beneath. In the second heaven, every hindering spirit I command you to scatter. Every territorial power blocking my blessings, I overthrow your throne. Every prince of Persia assigned to delay my breakthrough. I paralyze you by the authority in the name of Jesus. Angels of the living God, I commission you right now to go forth [music] and clear every pathway. Break through every barrier. Escort my blessings from the throne room to my location. Let there be no more delay. Let there be no more hindrance. I decree acceleration. I decree speed. I decree suddenly. Every door that the enemy has shut against my [music] prosperity, I command you to open right now in the name of Jesus. Every gate of brass be broken. Every bar of iron be cut as I walk through doors that no man can shut. I access opportunities that are reserved for the chosen. I step into dimensions of favor that defy human logic. People will favor me for no natural reason. Contracts will locate me. business ideas will download into my spirit. Divine connections will find me because I am walking in supernatural prosperity. Every evil eye monitoring my progress to bewitch me, I command that eye to go blind right now in Jesus name. Every satanic monitoring gadget tracking my finances to manipulate them, I destroy you by fire. Every witchcraft projection into my business, into my career, into my account, I scatter it. I nullify it. I render it powerless. From today, I am walking in divine secrecy. The enemy cannot track me. The adversary cannot monitor me. I am hidden in Christ. I am covered by the blood. I am protected by fire. I speak to my business, my career, my investments, my sources of [music] income. I command you to flourish. I command you to prosper. I command you to multiply in the name of Jesus. Let there be unusual growth. Let there be supernatural increase. Let there be uncommon expansion. What has been stagnant begin to move. What has been dominant wake up. What has been declining begin to rise. I prophesy acceleration. I prophesy multiplication. I prophesy abundance. Every seed I have swn, I command a hundfold return. Every offering I have given, I command it to speak for me. Every tithe I have paid, I command it to open the windows of heaven over my life. The Bible says in Malachi 3:10, "Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse, that there may be meat in mine house, and prove me now herewith, sayeth the Lord of hosts, if I will not open you the windows of heaven, and pour you out a blessing, that there shall not be room enough [music] to receive it. Father, I have brought my tithes. I have brought my offerings. Now, I demand that you open THE WINDOWS, POUR OUT the blessing, let it overflow, let it run over. Let it be pressed down, shaken together, and running over. I decree that money is pursuing me. Wealth is chasing me. Riches are following me. I don't have to chase money. Money is chasing me. The Bible says in Deuteronomy 28:2, "And all these blessings shall come on thee and overtake thee, if thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the Lord thy God. Blessings are overtaking me, favor is overtaking me, opportunities are overtaking me, breakthrough [music] is overtaking me. I cannot run away from prosperity because prosperity is running after me. Every enemy of my prosperity, you are arrested by fire. Every personality working against my financial advancement, you are paralyzed. Every colleague plotting my demotion, you will fail. Every competitor using witchcraft against my business, you are exposed and disgraced. Every family member jealous of my progress, your evil plans will not stand. I am surrounded by the fire of God. I am protected by warrior angels. No weapon formed against my prosperity shall prosper. Father, I ask for divine wisdom concerning my finances. The Bible says in James 1:5, "If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God that giveth to all men liberally and upgraded not, and it shall be given him. Give me wisdom to manage wealth. Give me strategies for business. Give me ideas for investment. Give me insight for multiplication. [music] Let me be like Solomon who received wisdom that made him the richest man in his generation. Let me be like Joseph, who received insight that made him prime minister of Egypt. Let me be like Daniel, who received understanding that made him thrive in a foreign land. I decree that I will not labor in vain. Every effort I put in shall yield results. Every work of my hand shall prosper. Every business venture shall succeed. Every investment shall multiply. I am planted by the rivers of water. My leaf shall not wither. Whatsoever I do shall prosper. This is not my hope. This is not my wish. This is my decree. This is my reality. I am operating in the blessing of the Lord that makes rich and adds no sorrow. Every evil dream of poverty, I cancel you. Every nightmare of failure, I nullify you. Every vision of lack that the enemy has been projecting into my sleep, I scatter it by fire. From today I will dream prosperity dreams. I will see visions of abundance. I will have revelations of wealth. My subconscious is reprogrammed for prosperity. My mind is renewed for abundance. My spirit is aligned with divine provision. I speak to my account multiply. I speak to my business expand. I speak to my salary increase. I speak to my investments appreciate. I speak to my opportunities show up. I speak to my favor overflow in the mighty name of Jesus. Let there be a supernatural turnaround. What has been declining for years begin to rise. What has been stagnant for months begin to flow. What has been closed for seasons begin to open. This is my season of reversal. This is my time of restoration. This is my moment of breakthrough. Every good thing that the enemy has stolen from me, from my family, from my lineage, I recover it all by fire. The Bible says in Joel 2:25, "And I will restore to you the years that the locust had eaten. Father, restore unto me everything that has been devoid. Every lost opportunity, restore it. Every wasted year, compensate [music] me. Every stolen blessing, return it sevenfold. I claim the restoration anointing. I walk in the recovery mandate. I operate in the reclamation grace. From this morning forward, I am stepping into a new financial season. Old levels are expired. Former limitations are terminated. Previous struggles are over. I am entering dimensions I have never experienced. I am accessing realms I have never seen. I am tapping into supplies I have never touched. This is supernatural prosperity. This is covenant wealth. This is kingdom abundance. I thank you, Father, for answered prayer. I thank you that what I have decreed this morning is already done in the spirit realm. Now I release my faith for the manifestation in the physical realm. I will see it. I will touch it. I will experience it because you are faithful to your word. Your promises are yes and amen. What you [music] have said, you will do. What you have spoken you will bring to pass in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. I have prayed and every demonic force, every satanic agent, every witchcraft manipulation, every ancestral spirit, every household wickedness, you have had this prayer. You are bound. You are paralyzed. You are terminated. Release your captives. Open your gates. Let go of what belongs to the children of God. And I seal this prayer with the blood of Jesus. I cover myself, my family, my business, my finances with the blood. No evil can penetrate. No harm can access. No weapon can succeed. I am protected. I am shielded. I am covered. Amen. Now, as we close, I want you to walk in the consciousness of this prayer. Don't go back to fear. Don't go back to worry. Don't go back to anxiety. You have prayed. You have decreed. You have declared. Now walk in faith. The Bible says in Mark 11:24, "Therefore I say unto you, what things soever ye desire when ye pray, believe that ye receive them, and ye shall have them. Believe that you have received." Walk like a prosperous person, think like a wealthy person, talk like a blessed person. Your breakthrough is done. Your prosperity is settled. Your wealth is established in Jesus's mighty name. Amen. And amen.
